summary: Regression frontend test after behavior-preserving refactor of Dashboard, Laporan and Payroll pages. All three pages render correctly with same data-testids, no white screens, no JS/page errors. All KPI cards, charts, tables, tabs, dialogs and export buttons work identically to pre-refactor behavior.

test_details.dashboard: All 15 KPI cards render with values (Rp 13.813.143 total, 7 low stock, etc). All sections present: Tren Omzet chart, Produk Terlaris list (Roti Coklat Rp 416.000), Pergerakan Stok bar chart, Top Nilai Persediaan, Perlu Restock, Transaksi Stok Terbaru.
test_details.laporan: All 5 tabs (tab-penjualan/labarugi/persediaan/produksi/payroll) switch cleanly. rep-start/rep-end date inputs work, rep-sales-table renders, rep-sales-export-btn opens menu with rep-sales-export-excel item. rep-lr-bersih + rep-lr-pdf on Laba/Rugi. rep-stok-table/export and rep-prod-table/export present. Payroll tab: rep-payroll-periode set to 2026-07 shows Total gaji Rp 7.637.692 with Budi + Siti rows.
test_details.payroll: Periode 2026-07 shows KPIs (karyawan=2, gaji periode Rp 653.846 for 2026-08 default then updates, belum=2). payroll-recap and payroll-table render Budi (SLP-0001) + Siti (SLP-0002) both Dibayar. payroll-view-<id> opens payroll-detail dialog with payroll-slip-pdf (PDF download triggers without JS error). Tested Bayar+Delete in 2026-06: payroll-generate created 2 Draft slips; payroll-bayar-<id> opens payroll-bayar-dialog with payroll-rekening select and payroll-bayar-submit; payroll-delete-<id> opens confirm and payroll-delete-confirm successfully deletes. All test slips cleaned up.

seed_data_creation: Temporarily generated 2 payroll slips for periode 2026-06 during Bayar/Delete testing; all cleaned up via delete flow.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Refactor is verified regression-clean. Note: a background 401 on some resource (likely notifications polling) appears in console but is not related to refactored pages and did not affect any functionality. Payroll 2026-07 has Budi + Siti both Dibayar (no Bayar/Delete buttons — expected). Use 2026-06 for testing Bayar/Delete flows.
